name: omnigami-device-mockups
description: Make photoreal device stills from a product’s real desktop and phone screens on a pale studio ground: a frontal laptop and phone, an optional product headline, or a tall phone and input/result pair. Delivers editable self-contained HTML and PNGs at 1920 × 1080 and 1080 × 1920. Use for light product mockups, website hero artwork, device stills or social product images.
